3. By means of this writ petition, 
petitioner has challenged the impugned 
orders dated 23.02.2023 passed by the 
respondent No.4 as Disciplinary 
Authority; dated 05.12.2023 passed by 
respondent No.3 as Appellate Authority; 
and order dated 18.12.2023 passed by 
respondent No.4, under the provisions of 
Uttarakhand (Uttar Pradesh) Police 
Officers of the Subordinate Ranks 
(Punishment and Appeal) Rules, 1991 
(Annexure Nos.1, 2 & 3 respectively to 
this writ petition) and other ancillary 
relief.
4. Learned counsel for the respondents 
prays for and is granted six weeks’ time to 
file counter affidavit.
5. Two weeks’ time, thereafter, is 
granted to the petitioner to file rejoinder 
affidavit.
